summary: Two churches: Assumption (Wildwood Crest) and St. Ann (Wildwood). Year-round Masses and the October-May confession box agree in both bulletins read (all pages are images); summer-only Masses are left out under R33. Open: Adoration hours given only on the website (the bulletins point to a missing page 11 for extended Tuesday hours) and a website Tuesday Benediction.

Left out; update mode should add them from summer bulletins.

sources.said: Tuesday Adoration has been extended until evening, from 9am until 6pm, in the Church of the Assumption, followed by Benediction, beginning at 7pm.
Extended Adoration Hours on Tuesdays See page 11 for more information
Extended Adoration Hours on Tuesdays See page 11 for more information

slots.rationale: R29, R6: both bulletins announce 'Extended Adoration Hours on Tuesdays' but the page they point to (page 11) is not in either PDF (10 pages). The website gives the hours and fits that announcement, but heads the page 'NEW ADORATION SCHEDULE AND BENEDICTION SERVICE - SIGN UP SHEET - COMING SOON', so whether the hours are in effect is unclear. Leaning include: the bulletin confirms extended Tuesday hours are current.
slots.question: Add the website's Tuesday Adoration, 9 AM-6 PM in Assumption Church?

sources.said: Tuesday Adoration ... from 9am until 6pm, in the Church of the Assumption, followed by Benediction, beginning at 7pm.

slots.rationale: R29, R6: website only. 'Followed by' conflicts with a one-hour gap after the 6 PM end, and the page says the Benediction service is 'coming soon'. Leaning leave out: a wrong time is worse than a missing one.
slots.question: Add Tuesday Benediction at 7 PM in Assumption Church (website only)?

sources.said: See Sign up Sheet for Monday Wednesday Thursday Friday Adoration from 9am until 1pm in the Saint Joseph Room, Assumption Church.

slots.rationale: R29, R6, R38: no bulletin prints these hours; only the website, under a 'NEW ADORATION SCHEDULE ... COMING SOON' heading. The St. Joseph Room is at Assumption Church. Leaning include because the bulletins' Tuesday 'extended' hours imply regular hours on other days. If included, the third-Monday 9 AM Holy Hour lies inside the Monday period (R37) and should be dropped as a separate slot.
